input.free_text_description: This system is a search platform that serves User roles. The system includes access control and identity verification to protect resources and manage sessions. Secondary concerns include API gateway functionality.

user_stories.story: As a User, I want to access the system through a well-defined interface, so that I can perform my tasks efficiently.
As a User, I want to view a summary of my recent activity, so that I can track my progress.
As a User, I want to update my preferences and settings, so that the system adapts to my needs.
As a User, I want to export data in a standard format, so that I can use it in external tools.
As a User, I want to receive feedback on my actions, so that I know the system processed my request.
